newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Bridgestone to buy M&R's Fedstone.
newsitem.headline: Bridgestone to buy M&R's Fedstone.

text.p: Murray and Roberts Holdings Ltd said on Monday that Bridgestone Corp of Japan had agreed in principle to buy its Fedstone tyre subsidiary for some 290 million rand.
The deal is expected to be finalised before the end of December.
According to an M&R spokesman the sale is subject to the signature of a formal shareholders' agreement.

The largest subsidiary in the Fedstone stable is branded tyre manufacturer Firestone SA. M&R chief executive Graham Hardy said the transaction would boost Firestone's exports as it would benefit from the latest production and tyre technology methods.
"This in turn will increase the level of foreign currency earnings to the benefit of South Africa as a whole," Hardy said.

Hardy said the envisaged sale was a further step in M&R's ongoing strategy of focusing on core activities. It does not regard retailing and wholesaling, which Firestone and other Fedstone subsidiaries engage in, as core, he said.
The overall financial effects of the transaction would be fully quantified once a formal contract had been finalised.
